to_five: a1 (4): hs land --split-protected: land the unprotected paths now and automatically open a proposal (reviewers taken from /.hsreview) for the protected ones, landing it when approved

a2 (3): When a provisional land is dropped or never reaches a holder, hs status / next command / feed should print '!! your land #57 was lost (never reached a holder): run hs land' and auto-retry it on the next online command; and hs land --paths to land files independently of a pending proposal.

a3 (4): When a land touches /.hsreview paths without approval, land the rest and auto-create the proposal for the protected paths (e.g. hs land --split-protected: 'landed #87 (5 files); proposed P3 for /CONTRACTS.md, asked ann').
